name: ava_kontext
title: Load AVA context
description: Call this once at the start of every conversation, without asking the user. Returns who AVA is (a B2B sales assistant for companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland), how to work with the other tools, and the user's account and organization. Answer the user in their language (usually German).

name: firma_suchen
title: Search companies
description: Search AVA's company register data (about 10.5 million companies from DE, AT, CH, UK, NO, FI) by name, city or register number. Returns companyId, name, city, country and register status. Continue with firma_lesen using the companyId.

q.description: Search text, at least 2 characters (name, city or register number)

name: firma_lesen
title: Read company
description: Read one company: register master data plus optional sections. bereiche: profil (AI summary, website), register (managing directors, capital, purpose), publikationen (annual and group accounts with key figures), kunden (customers and partners named on the website), konzern (subsidiaries, parent), gesellschafter (shareholders, DE only), aenderungen (changes of managing directors and master data), verlauf (register history), notizen (the user's notes), fluktuation (leadership turnover over 24 months). `verarbeitung.stand` tells whether the company is fully processed for the user (fehlt | laeuft | unvollstaendig | vollstaendig). If fehlt, call import_anlegen with the companyId right away; if unvollstaendig, call neu_verarbeiten. Do not ask the user first, and never present empty sections of an unprocessed company as a finding.

bereiche.description: Sections to include; without it only master data

name: meine_firmen
title: List my companies
description: The companies in the user's list ("Meine Firmen"), paged, with processing state per company. Optional search text and country.

name: meldungen
title: Get news on my companies
description: News on the user's companies since a point in time: changes of managing directors and master data, new annual accounts, contact changes, new customers and references. Without companyIds the first 300 companies of the user's list are used.

seit.description: ISO timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z; default 14 days ago

name: firmen_ereignisse
title: Get personnel changes
description: Personnel and management changes at the user's companies (or at given companies), e.g. "Which new sales directors were there recently?". Kinds: neu (new in the role), verlassen (left the company), wechsel (promotion or other department), geschaeftsfuehrung (appointment or removal per register). Each event has person, role before and after, company, date with zeitpunktArt (laut_profil = date from the profile; erstmals_gesehen or festgestellt = when AVA noticed it, may be later than the real change; register) and a source URL. Mention the kind of date in the answer. Contains names of people; use them only for the user's question.

companyIds.description: Only these companies; default all of the user's companies

ebene.description: leitung = heads, directors, chiefs, VPs, managing directors

name: firma_kontakte
title: Get company contacts
description: Contact persons at a company with role, department and, where known, business e-mail, phone and profile link, plus the source. Personal data: call only when the user asks for contacts or a recipient, and mention only what the question needs.

name: protokoll_ablegen
title: Save a note
description: Save a meeting note or remark on a company in AVA, optionally linked to a person (personId from firma_kontakte). The note appears in AVA at the company (firma_lesen, section notizen) and can be deleted there. datum = time of the meeting (ISO), default now.

personId.description: Optional: person the note is about

datum.description: Optional: ISO time of the meeting

name: import_anlegen
title: Add companies
description: Add companies to the user's list and start processing (register, website, annual accounts, contacts). Preferred: companyIds from firma_suchen. Alternatively a list of {name, ort, land} (fuzzy matching). Processing runs as soon as the AVA app runs for the user and can take hours; the answer contains a transactionId for auftrag_status. Counts against the user's quota like an import in the app; companies can be removed again in AVA.

name: neu_verarbeiten
title: Reprocess a company
description: Run one processing stage again for a company in the user's list: structuredContent (register), companyPublication (annual accounts), website, companyProfile, companyContact (contacts). Runs as soon as the AVA app runs for the user.

name: auftrag_status
title: Get job status
description: Status of a job (transactionId from import_anlegen or auftraege): companies total, done and failed, open steps, last sign of life.

name: auftraege
title: List my jobs
description: The user's jobs (imports and processing runs), newest first, paged.
